QLD.currencyWarning: The QDC MP 1.1 and MP 1.2 text used here is the 11 March 2010 version. Per the Queensland Government page (https://www.business.qld.gov.au/industries/building-property-development/building-construction/laws-codes-standards/queensland-development-code) it is superseded by the Queensland Housing Code (QHC; listed 14 August 2026, commenced 1 September 2026). The QHC applies in a local government area only once the planning scheme is amended to say how it applies, or from 1 September 2029; until then the 2010 QDC parts continue.
QLD.variationNote: A council planning scheme can vary these standards (QDC siting can be varied via planning scheme/alternative solutions); not verified per council here.

front.note: Access place or access street 3.0m; collector street 4.0m. If existing dwellings on both adjoining lots with one setback 3m-6m (A1(a)(ii)): difference not more than 2m = distance between the two buildings; more than 2m = average of the adjacent road setbacks.

garage.note: A1(b): garage/carport follows A1(a); openings facing street lesser of 6m and 50% of frontage. Corner truncation: no structure over 2m high within a 9m x 9m truncation.
